page.overview:
Who is Marillin Gemalphin?

Marillin Gemalphin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She is skinny, with dreamy blue eyes and lifeless brown hair. She has a narrow face.

She loves cats and other animals, quite possibly more than she likes people, going out of her way to Heal stray cats.

Marillin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among thirteen sisters that fled with Liandrin, only Liandrin is stronger, although Eldrith Jhondar is only slightly weaker. When the much weaker Temaile Kinderode calls her a fool, Marillin is quick to reminder her who should stand higher among them, a fact observed by Elayne Trakand.
